title: Annotatio IV §.XV: Hildebrand involves Berengar of Tours, century’s chief Eucharistic confessor
pass_a_gloss: But just as Hildebrand’s Tyranny raged against the Emperors themselves, especially against Henry IV, so also it involved the most Celebrated Confessor of Eucharistic truth of that Age, BERENGAR OF TOURS, though for another cause.
pass_b_english: As Hildebrand’s tyranny raged against the Emperors — especially Henry IV — so it also involved that age’s most celebrated Eucharistic confessor.
BERENGAR OF TOURS — though for another cause.
source_text: Quemadmodum verò Tyrannis Hildebrandi in ipsos Imperatores, maxime in Henricum IV. sæviit, ita quoque veritatis Eucharisticæ Confessorem ejus Seculi Celeberrimum BERENGARIUM ANDEGAVENSEM, quanquam alia de causa, involvit.
